correctness.rationale: The depth-of-first-occurrence recursion is exact. Induction makes M_i the unique minimal witness; every distinct same-depth witness is >=2M_i for large i. Euler products follow from multiplicativity and uniform summability of p^{-q}; positive local factors bound the full limit below. The event v_r(n)=M_i and all other valuations fully admissible has exact density K_S r^{-M_i}. All competing events have density O(r^{-2M_i}+s^{-M_i}), yielding the asymptotic by squeezing. Exact finite checks verify minimal witnesses and truncated local factors, not the infinite limit. Limits and domain restrictions are explicit.

value.rationale: A natural gap links finite-level mosaic densities to complete-tower forbidden-prime probabilities. The theorem determines the precise and extraordinarily rapid loss at each extra level, identifies the unique minimal prime-power tower driving the limit, and gives a nonzero Euler-product leading coefficient for every fixed finite prime set. It is structural, infinite and not a table lookup or arbitrary narrow computation.
